findings.result: The outline permits change, and the main argument explicitly allows both changing and retaining the previous value; no deterministic per-step flip is asserted.

final_lf_policy: Only replacing the final run of LF bytes with one LF is semantically ignored. The normalized-source SHA256 binds that exact allowed variant; interior whitespace or text changes are outside this receipt.
